notes.title: Next Fest Demo Survey
notes.content:
Hey Gamesmiths!

🎮 Did you dive into the Adventure Forge demo during Steam Next Fest? We want to hear from you! 🌟 Your feedback is like gold to us as we continue polishing the Adventure Forge for early access release. 

Please take a moment to fill out our Steam Next Fest Demo Survey and let us know your thoughts! Whether you conquered every challenge or stumbled upon hidden secrets, your experience matters. Help us shape the future of Adventure Forge! Click the link below to share your feedback and be part of the journey. 

[h3]Survey here: [/h3]

[h1][url=https://forms.gle/U1MXUVM4BAf1JdRm6]https://forms.gle/U1MXUVM4BAf1JdRm6[/url][/h1]
